dislocation.headline: No acute dislocation — markets are not in a stress washout.

gate2.label: Entry timer arms only inside a buyable washout.
gate2.measured: Matched buyable washouts (2006+): waiting for the term un-inversion lifted hit 61→67%, median 63d return +2.2→+4.6%, median drawdown −4.5→−2.9%; the 1-in-10 tail was marginally worse. A confirm, not a bottom-caller.

evidence.robust: Put-present washouts had ~4pp shallower MEDIAN 3-month drawdown than put-absent — the one effect whose 95% CI excludes zero ([+0.3, +6.3], episode block bootstrap, SPY 1997-2026).
evidence.sign_consistent: Higher hit-rate and a shallower 1-year tail point the same way but their CIs span zero at ~10 effective crises — carried by leave-one-year-out (26/28 years) and BOTH split-halves, not significance.
evidence.caveat: A drawdown / risk filter, not a return signal. In a Fed-put regime even knife-looking dips often recover; in a put-absent regime (recession or inflation-locked) the same capitulation signals caught the 2000/2008/2022 falling knife.

cross_asset.headline: CONCENTRATED — 3 of 6 markets are one bet (US, Commodities, Dollar). Cross-asset correlation is in the top 3% of its 5y range: stacking these views is doubling one liquidity/risk exposure, not diversifying.
cross_asset.evidence: Absorption ratio = PC1 variance share (Kritzman-Page 2010): high/rising absorption marks a fragile one-factor regime that has historically led drawdowns. Daily closes across US/Asia/24-7 crypto carry a timezone lead/lag — a coarse regime gauge, not a hedge ratio.

text.en: Rising real 10y yields lift the discount rate → long-duration equities, REITs and other long-duration assets de-rate first.
text.zh: 实际10年期收益率上行抬高贴现率→长久期股票、REITs等长久期资产首先承压。

text.en: Higher US real yields pull capital in → the dollar firms → gold, industrial commodities and EM are pressured.
text.zh: 美国实际收益率走高吸引资本流入→美元走强→黄金、工业商品与新兴市场受压。

text.en: A firm dollar + soft commodities → energy/materials relative headwind and EM-revenue exporters de-rate; financials are the relative beneficiary as curves steepen.
text.zh: 强美元＋商品走软→能源/材料相对承压、新兴市场营收型出口商估值下修；曲线变陡时金融为相对受益者。

title.zh: 通胀粘性／更高更久传导

text.en: Core PCE/CPI stuck above the 2% target → the market reprices the terminal rate higher (breakevens, policy path) → broad equities carry a valuation headwind.
text.zh: 核心PCE/CPI高于2%目标→市场上修终端利率（盈亏平衡、政策路径）→大盘股估值承压。

text.en: Higher-for-longer keeps real yields elevated → small caps and rate-sensitive borrowers are squeezed by financing cost.
text.zh: 更高更久使实际收益率维持高位→小盘股与利率敏感借款方被融资成本挤压。

text.en: PPI / ECI wage pressure compresses margins → defensives (staples, health care) relatively outperform.
text.zh: PPI／就业成本（ECI）工资压力压缩利润率→防御板块（必需消费、医疗）相对跑赢。

title.zh: 政策宽松／曲线变陡传导

text.en: Cuts priced (policy gap negative) → the front end falls and the curve bull-steepens → duration rallies.
text.zh: 计入降息（政策缺口为负）→短端下行、曲线牛市变陡→久期资产上涨。

text.en: A steeper curve → bank net-interest margins and rate-sensitive REITs/housing improve.
text.zh: 曲线变陡→银行净息差与利率敏感的REITs/地产改善。

text.en: Easier financial conditions → small caps and cyclicals lead a risk-on rotation.
text.zh: 金融条件转松→小盘与周期股领涨的风险偏好轮动。

text.en: Market inflation expectations drift above the model/survey → unanchoring risk; the dollar firms as the Fed is expected to stay restrictive. Counter-intuitively, gold's MEASURED response to this wedge is a headwind — the higher real yields from a restrictive Fed dominate the inflation-hedge bid.
text.zh: 市场通胀预期高于模型/调查→脱锚风险；美元因预期美联储维持紧缩而走强。与直觉相反，黄金对此缺口的实测反应为逆风——紧缩带来的更高实际收益率压过了通胀对冲买盘。

text.en: Unanchoring → the Fed stays restrictive → real yields rise; long-duration growth de-rates while defensives are relatively favored.
text.zh: 脱锚→美联储维持紧缩→实际收益率上行；长久期成长下修，防御相对受青睐。

text.en: The textbook 'real-asset hedge' (energy, materials, gold) is unreliable for this wedge: with the Fed held restrictive, the measured beneficiaries are the dollar and defensives, not the inflation-beneficiary sectors.
text.zh: 教科书式的“实物资产对冲”（能源、材料、黄金）对此缺口并不可靠：在美联储维持紧缩下，实测受益者是美元与防御板块，而非通胀受益板块。

desc.en: long rates falling faster than short — growth/inflation fears pulling the long end
desc.zh: 长端利率下行快于短端 — 增长/通胀担忧压低长端

fed_phase.en: Late-cycle growth scare — long end falling fastest on a safety bid, Fed not yet cutting
fed_phase.zh: 周期晚段增长恐慌——避险买盘压低长端最快，美联储尚未降息

note.en: A flight to duration: long Treasuries, bond-proxy defensives and gold lead. The long-end rally is also a tailwind for long-duration GROWTH — Growth > Value, with Health Care + IT favoured (Man Group / MSCI) — while cyclicals and small caps lag. The market is pricing slowing growth ahead of the Fed.
note.zh: 向久期避险：长债、类债券防御与黄金领先。长端走强亦利好长久期成长——成长优于价值，医疗与科技受青睐（Man Group / MSCI）——而周期与小盘落后。市场在美联储之前为增长放缓定价。

note.en: Funds 3.63% vs ~2.5% nominal-neutral = restrictive. Wright (2006): the same curve slope is more restrictive at a higher funds level — a flat curve at 5% funds is a stronger recession tell than at 2%.
note.zh: 联邦基金3.63% vs 约2.5%名义中性＝偏紧。Wright（2006）：相同曲线斜率在更高基金利率下更具紧缩性——5%基金利率下的平坦曲线比2%下更强的衰退信号。

lead_time_note.en: The near-term forward spread (3m rate ~18m forward − 3m bill) statistically dominates the 2s10s — Engstrom-Sharpe (Fed 2018-19) find it renders the 2s10s redundant in a joint probit. We read 3m10y, not 2s10s, as the recession slope (Estrella-Mishkin γ = −0.53, −0.66). The genuinely ominous configuration is the curve RE-STEEPENING out of a deep inversion: the un-inversion has historically COINCIDED WITH or slightly led recession onset (1990 ≈3m, 2001 ≈6m after the curve turned positive) — a fresh dis-inversion is the late-cycle handoff, not an all-clear.
lead_time_note.zh: 近端远期利差（约18个月远期3月利率−3月票据）在统计上优于2-10年——Engstrom-Sharpe（美联储2018-19）发现在联合probit中它使2-10年变得多余。我们以3月-10年（而非2-10年）作为衰退斜率（Estrella-Mishkin γ＝−0.53、−0.66）。真正危险的形态是深度倒挂后曲线重新变陡：历史上重新转正与衰退开始大致同步或略微领先（1990年约3个月、2001年约6个月），因此刚出现的重新变陡是周期晚段的交接，而非解除警报。

note.en: Forward rates are the market-implied future short rates embedded in today's curve; carry+roll-down is the total return a duration holder earns if the curve is unchanged in a year (the cushion before price loss).
note.zh: 远期利率是今日曲线隐含的市场预期未来短端利率；carry＋滚动收益是久期持有者在曲线一年不变时获得的总回报（价格亏损前的缓冲）。

core_macro.zh: 曲线：牛市平坦。衰退面板低（0/4 项亮起）。

label.en: Curve favours value over growth, large caps.
label.zh: 曲线倾向于价值优于成长、大盘。

note.en: Equity duration: growth stocks discount cash flows further out, so they behave as long-duration assets and de-rate when real yields rise (~2× the rate-sensitivity of value, BIS 2022); value/financials are short-duration. HONEST CAVEAT: the long-run correlation of the value-minus-growth factor with Δ10y is only ~0.10 (AQR/Asness) — the link is concentrated in episodes (the +25% growth→value rotation of 2022) and is largely NOT pure duration. Small caps are driven by the FRONT end (floating-rate debt cost), a distinct channel from value/growth duration.
note.zh: 股票久期：成长股贴现更远期的现金流，因而表现为长久期资产，实际收益率上行时估值下修（利率敏感度约为价值的2倍，BIS 2022）；价值/金融为短久期。诚实提醒：价值减成长因子与10年期变动的长期相关性仅约0.10（AQR/Asness）——该联系集中于特定时期（如2022年+25%的成长→价值轮动），且大部分并非纯久期效应。小盘由前端驱动（浮动利率债务成本），与价值/成长久期是不同的渠道。

cross_asset_confirm.headline_en: Bonds/FX diverge from the equity read — fast-family caution the equity gauges don't yet show (credit).
cross_asset_confirm.headline_zh: 债券/外汇与股票读数背离（领先板块出现股票计量尚未显示的谨慎信号）。

legs.detail_en: bonds read late-cycle while equities read mid-cycle — the bond clock is further along / more adverse
legs.detail_zh: 债券读数为周期晚段，股票为周期中段 — 债券时钟更靠后 / 更不利

legs.detail_en: bonds & FX confirm the risk-on equity read
legs.detail_zh: 债券与外汇确认了偏多的股票读数

caution_flags.en: High-yield credit widening from tight — credit risk-appetite turning (partly-leading via the EBP family, but often coincident with equity stress).
caution_flags.zh: 高收益信用从偏紧走阔 — 信用风险偏好转向（经EBP具部分领先性，但常与股票压力同步）。

cross_asset_confirm.note_en: Bonds & FX cross-check: does the fast-family complex (bonds + FX) agree with the equity/macro regime? DISPLAY-ONLY — never scored. Most legs are coincident confirmation / fragility gauges; only credit/EBP and the curve have a (noisy) leading horizon. Divergences are attention flags, not forecasts.
cross_asset_confirm.note_zh: 债券与外汇交叉验证：快端板块（债券+外汇）是否与股票/宏观周期一致？仅供展示 — 从不评分。多数为同步确认/脆弱性计量；仅信用/EBP与曲线具（嘈杂的）领先性。背离为关注信号，非预测。

vol_regime.vvix_state: complacent (vol-of-vol cheap vs vol — historically precedes rising vol)
vol_regime.doctrine: Index vol-regime: validated on 1990+ history, no dealer-sign assumption. Legs are SCORED only when the validation gate marks them earned; otherwise display/context. A regime read, not an intraday timer (delayed-EOD inputs).

risk_state.headline_en: Caution: fragility building (40/100). Drivers: SPX: dealers short gamma; net GEX -24.1bn; spot below gamma flip, complacency=watch (steep contango, HY widening), HY OAS +6bp/21d; HYG/TLT -2.2%/20d.

drivers.detail_en: SPX: dealers short gamma; net GEX -24.1bn; spot below gamma flip

dealer_gamma.detail_en: SPX: dealers short gamma; net GEX -24.1bn; spot below gamma flip

risk_state.reader_contract: Trim chasing; favor good entries over extended leaders.
risk_state.disclaimer: Conjunction-based early-warning composite; legs vary in validation (see research/RISK_LAYER_DESIGN.md §10). De-risk response is sizing, not stock selection. Does not alter the validated regime quad.

risk_radar.headline_en: CAUTION: Growth scare / defensive rotation (91/100) + Growth scare / defensive rotation × Credit stress. Leading: growth_defensives(93%), growth_cyc_def(89%). Modest odds (~1.5-2x) — de-risk, favor entries.
risk_radar.headline_zh: CAUTION：Growth scare / defensive rotation（91/100）。降低风险敞口、择优入场。

drawdown_prob.measure: >=5% SPY pullback (empirical 2006-2026; rises with intensity + conjunction)

flow_status.note: options-flow vol legs (put/call, GEX) accrue forward — deep history is unavailable freely; they activate + self-validate via the Opus loop when mature

risk_radar.reader_contract: Trim chasing; favor good entries over extended leaders; honor stops.
risk_radar.disclaimer: Evidence-gated leading-risk radar (research/RISK_ENGINE_V2_FINDINGS.md). Edge is MODEST (~1.5-2x conditional lift, not a forecast) and LOUD+EARLY by design — every alert prints its measured lift/lead, a forward-outcome log grades every call, and the Opus review loop retunes from its mistakes. De-risk = sizing, not selection; the validated regime quad is untouched.

vol_shock.outcome_label_zh: 10 日内标普回撤 ≤ −5% 或 VIX 日内高点 ≥ 1.4 倍
vol_shock.disclaimer: Display-only / validation-accruing — a FORWARD vol-shock RISK gauge fused from leading precursors, NOT an alpha signal. It feeds no score and no allocation; each firing is logged and graded on forward data.
vol_shock.disclaimer_zh: 仅供展示／正在积累验证——由领先前兆融合而成的「前瞻性波动冲击风险」计，并非选股信号。不计入任何评分或仓位；每次触发均会记录并以未来数据评分。

playbook.headline: Goldilocks — growth improving while inflation cools. Posture: CAREFUL — reduce size, tighten stops, let cash build.

dial.meaning: reduce size, tighten stops, let cash build
dial.meaning_zh: 缩小仓位、收紧止损、逐步积累现金
reasons: Fed liquidity is contracting — a persistent headwind for risk assets (S&P positive next month only ~62.3% of the time vs ~71.4% when expanding — odds, not a point forecast; regime read lagged 3bd)
美联储流动性正在收缩 — 对风险资产构成持续逆风（S&P 次月为正的概率仅约 62.3%，扩张时约 71.4% — 这是胜率而非点预测；周期读数滞后 3 个交易日）
Transition radar reads WEAKENING (2+ warning flags) — no action required yet, but stop adding regime-dependent risk
转换雷达显示走弱（2 个以上预警标志）— 暂无需操作，但停止增加依赖周期的风险
Signal agreement is low (25%) — the regime label itself is uncertain; neutral posture caps apply
信号一致度偏低（25%）— 周期标签本身不确定；适用中性立场上限

watchlist.name: Financials
watchlist.why: Historically favored if the regime shifts to Reflation. Currently improving (+8.3% vs the market this month). Don't buy in anticipation — wait for the trend cross. Trigger distance: needs +3.5% more outperformance vs the market to confirm — already 70% of the way there from its recent low. Seasonality: Jul: +1.9% avg, up 67% of years (n=27).
watchlist.why_zh: 若周期转向 再通胀，历史上受青睐。当前为改善 （本月相对市场 +8.3%）。不要提前买入 — 等待趋势交叉。 触发距离：还需相对市场再多 +3.5% 的超额表现方可确认 — 自近期低点已完成 70% 的路程。 季节性：7月：平均 +1.9%，67% 的年份上涨（n=27）。

triggers: The most fragile support is the 2-year Treasury yield direction — if it rolls over, the growth signal flips.
最脆弱的支撑是2 年期美债收益率方向 — 若其反转，growth 信号将翻转。
Warning already active: the signals behind the regime are losing agreement.
预警已激活：支撑当前周期的信号一致度正在下降。
Warning already active: options positioning suggests a fragile, swingy market.
预警已激活：期权持仓显示市场脆弱、波动加剧。
For a shift to Reflation, watch for inflation expectations and energy turning up while growth holds.
若要转向 再通胀，关注 通胀预期与能源走高，而增长保持稳健。

playbook.honesty: Sector picks vs the index showed no stable edge in our 2000-2026 backtest (results flip between decades) — so sector calls here are risk filters and confirmation tools, not return predictions. The exposure dial conditions are the statistically robust part.
playbook.honesty_zh: 在我们 2000-2026 年的回测中，相对指数的板块选择并无稳定优势 （结果在不同年代间反复翻转）— 因此这里的板块判断是风险过滤与确认工具，而非回报预测。仓位刻度盘的条件才是统计上稳健的部分。
